name: Evarist
description:
Every customer need, hesitation, and buying signal is already in your traffic. Traditional analytics leave your team to find them. Evarist does the analysis for you. Google Analytics, rebuilt for AI.
- Ask anything about your website traffic: What changed this week? Which visitors are closest to buying? Why are fewer visitors becoming customers this month? Which campaigns changed? Where do ready-to-buy visitors leave? Every answer comes with session-level evidence, traceable back to the real journeys behind it.
- Evarist monitors your traffic 24/7 and surfaces what matters before you think to look: traffic sources and campaigns, demand and intent by audience, conversion journeys and funnel drops, revenue linked to each change, and AI traffic from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and other assistants, measured on whether it creates real business value. And your own agents can act on that intelligence.
- Evarist knows your business (your offer, products, content, and website structure) and reads every session: every page, click, interaction, conversion, and revenue event. Privacy-first: behavioral understanding, not personal identification. One lightweight script, installed once, no analytics configuration project.
- Built on infrastructure processing 60B+ events and 25M+ daily sessions. For marketing teams, e-commerce, SaaS, and lead-generation sites with real conversion questions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Evarist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Evarist to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.evarist.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Evarist MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Evarist lists 16 MCP tools, including create_site, describe_data, execute_query, list_sites, manage_team, campaign_performance, revenue_summary, setup_shopify, set_event_goal, list_products, propose_event_tag, and confirm_event_tag.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Evarist?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Evarist in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Evarist requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Evarist is developed by Evarist. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
